narrative: Presents evidence that Mandelbrot-like fractal structure appears in physical systems — quasicrystals, magnetic domain walls, and charge density waves — not as visual coincidence but as a natural consequence of local iterative rules operating in physical substrates. The central philosophical argument is that the mathematics is substrate-independent: crystals produce fractal boundaries because that is what local iteration generates at boundaries, not because any computation of the Mandelbrot set is occurring.
